description: Ownership map for release-ledger artifact classes. Every manifest artifact kind must be represented here so release operators can identify the generator, checker, manifest relationship, schema relationship, package relationship, and exemption boundary for each checked-in release artifact class.

entries.manifest_relationship: Manifest-bound schema artifacts; bytes and sha256 are owned by sync-release-schema-artifacts.py.
entries.schema_relationship: Each schema artifact is indexed by schemas/index.json.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.

entries.manifest_relationship: Manifest-bound schema index; bytes and sha256 are owned by sync-release-schema-artifacts.py.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.

generated_by: manual registry updates and source-specific patch scripts
entries.manifest_relationship: Canonical registry artifact is manifest-bound and checksum-verifiable.
entries.package_relationship: Primary artifact in release packages and shard generation.
entries.exemption_boundary: Canonical data changes require their own bounded ticket and compatibility evidence.

entries.manifest_relationship: Top-level catalog and provider evidence artifacts are manifest-bound.
entries.schema_relationship: Each JSON report declares a schema URI when a schema exists.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.
entries.exemption_boundary: Manual report edits must be followed by generator/check ownership or explicit release documentation.

entries.manifest_relationship: Error catalog and routing rollup are manifest-bound release evidence.
entries.schema_relationship: Validated against error catalog and error-action-routing schemas.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.
entries.exemption_boundary: Routing changes should preserve bounded action IDs and manual-review boundaries.

generated_by: manual checked-in decision record plus python scripts/validate-credential-runtime-manual-review-decision.py
entries.manifest_relationship: Source rollups, credential runtime evidence, operator packets, manual-review acceptance packets, and inventories are top-level manifest evidence for nested source reports, reviewed receipt collection actions, and explicit manual-review release boundary actions.
entries.schema_relationship: Schema-backed source and credential reports are indexed through schemas/index.json and source-report-inventory.json where applicable.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.
entries.exemption_boundary: Nested source reports stay out of the top-level manifest when covered by source-report-inventory.json.

entries.manifest_relationship: Downstream impact and compatibility evidence are manifest-bound.
entries.schema_relationship: Validated against registry-impact-plan, release-distribution-footprint, release-consumer-compatibility, and release-consumer-decision schemas.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.
entries.exemption_boundary: The release impact rollup must keep release_evidence_inputs for error/action routing and source report inventory, while validation checks the consumer compatibility downstream impact contract, release distribution footprint, release-health rollup generation contract, runtime risk evidence contract, and consumer decision report. The footprint and decision reports exclude their own manifest artifact bytes or decision inputs to avoid self-referential drift. Source runtime blockers or warnings must stay bound to source runtime evidence, error/action routing, downstream impact, and manual-review compatibility gates until resolved.

entries.manifest_relationship: Release assembly receipt, goal finish preflight, goal continuation queue, and goal operating contract are manifest-bound evidence for the operator command sequence, workflow alignment, goal finish boundary, next safe child selection, and persistent registry-ledger goal vision.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.
entries.exemption_boundary: The receipt, preflight, continuation queue, operating contract, and guard must not claim goal completion. They record the release assembly path, current manual-review boundaries, release consumer decision, goal finish allowance, goal vision, and next child candidates so #344 remains open until a completion audit proves closure; the guard is the operator precondition before running gira goal finish.

entries.manifest_relationship: Latest verification receipts and external probe receipts are manifest-bound evidence.
entries.schema_relationship: Validated through verification and verification-summary schemas.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.
entries.exemption_boundary: Release verification/readiness receipts generated from a selected manifest are explicit manifest-derived receipts. They stay outside manifest.json because the manifest is the source artifact they validate.

entries.manifest_relationship: Human-readable release context files are manifest-bound for checksum verification.
entries.package_relationship: Included in release packages through manifest.json.
entries.exemption_boundary: Manual edits are allowed, but manifest bytes and sha256 must be refreshed deterministically.

distribution_artifacts.relationship: Release zip entries must match manifest.json plus every manifest artifact path. When a shard archive is present, the release zip check must also prove that the shard archive source registry sha matches the selected release manifest registry artifact.
Optional shard archive evidence must match the same canonical registry as the selected release manifest when attached.
